Compute the two perimeters symbolically: P(BCF)=BC+CF+BF=BC+2+BF and P(BAF)=AB+AF+BF=7+2+BF. The common terms BF and 2 cancel, so the perimeter difference is BC-7 if the diagram/text imply triangle BCF has the larger perimeter. Set BC-7=3 and get BC=10.
